messages:
sara: Hey team — PR #50322 touches runtime eviction config + routing fallback. Need quick owners: runtime, platform, infra, security. Hoping for approvals today so we can land in tomorrow's merge window. TL;DR: changes eviction LRU thresholds, adds routing policy toggle, and requests KMS key access.

David: @sara I can own platform review. Quick question: does the routing toggle require controller schema changes? If yes, need migration notes.

Tori: I can take runtime. Noticed one unit test failing locally (kv eviction test). I’ll try repro and push a fix if it's trivial.

Sam: @sara @Tori ping from infra — does this change allocator pinning or ulimit hints? We need perf numbers before ok'ing infra config changes.

Alice: Security here. KMS access needs threat model + KMS IAM principal list. Also flag me if plaintext keys are introduced anywhere.

Sara: Thanks — answers inline:
- routing toggle: controller schema unchanged, it's a config flag only (no migration)
- allocator: no pinning change, but LRU threshold diff might increase eviction churn for heavy long-lived sessions
- KMS: only for signing rollout tokens; no plaintext keys in repo

Jen: Small ops note: please add labels "needs-security" and "needs-infra" to the PR so triage picks it up.

ci-bot: CI pipeline complete: unit ✅, integration ❌ (flaky timeout on orchestration test). Investigating.

Tori: Repro of failing test: run `./dev/run_tests.sh -k test_kv_eviction` — timing sensitive. I'll add a small retry in the fixture and file a follow-up cleanup PR if it passes.

David: Platform thumbs up on routing toggle semantics. Can you include a sample rollout plan? e.g., 10%->50%->100% over 4 hours + automatic rollback on error spikes.

Sara: adding rollout snippet to PR description now, and attaching perf histogram from staging run (p95 latency delta ~+4ms under heavy load).

Sam: That perf delta is okay for infra; but if p99 shifts >15ms we may need to revisit caching knobs. Can you add a perf test that forces mem pressure?

Alice: Once you add threat model + KMS principal list I'll do a security pass. Leave the PR in "needs-security" until then.

Sara: Will do. ETA: I'll push updates in ~30m and ping back here. Thanks everyone :pray:

Tori: cool, I'll queue runtime LGTM after the flaky test fix.

Sam: tagging infra review for tomorrow's merge window if all green.

Alice: leaving an inline comment about key rotation cadence — please address.

Sara: update pushed — added rollout plan, perf stress command, threat model, and KMS principal list. @ci-bot can you re-run integrations?

ci-bot: Re-run scheduled.

ci-bot: All checks passed ✅. Merge queue eligible.

David: Adding my approval. @sara you can schedule into tomorrow's 09:00 UTC merge window.

Tori: LGTM (runtime)

Sam: LGTM (infra)

Alice: LGTM (security) — verified threat model and principals.

Sara: awesome — thanks all, merging after window opens. :tada:
